title: Rent Agreement
shortDesc: For renting flats, rooms, or houses
shortDesc_hi: मकान, फ्लैट या कमरा किराए पर देने हेतु

questions.label: Full Name of Landlord (Property Owner)
questions.hint: Name as per Aadhaar / PAN card

questions.label: Full Name of Tenant
questions.hint: Name of the person who will sign the lease
questions.hint_hi: जो व्यक्ति लीज पर हस्ताक्षर करेगा

questions.label: Full Address of Rented Property
questions.label_hi: किराए के मकान/फ्लैट का पूरा पता
questions.placeholder: Flat 302, Palm Heights, Sector 14, Gurugram, Haryana - 122001
questions.hint: Include flat number, building, locality, and pincode
questions.hint_hi: फ्लैट नं., इमारत और पिनकोड अवश्य लिखें

questions.label: Monthly Rent Amount (in ₹)
questions.hint: Amount payable each month, excluding electricity/water
questions.hint_hi: बिजली और पानी के बिल के अलावा प्रति माह की राशि

questions.label: Refundable Security Deposit (in ₹)
questions.hint_hi: मकान खाली करते समय वापस मिलने वाली राशि

questions.label: Agreement Duration (in Months)
questions.hint: Standard in India is 11 months to avoid mandatory registration
questions.hint_hi: भारत में पंजीकरण से बचने हेतु सामान्यतः 11 महीने रखे जाते हैं

questions.label: Agreement Start Date
questions.hint_hi: जिस दिन से किराएदारी शुरू हो रही है

questions.label: Notice Period to Vacate (in Days)
questions.label_hi: खाली करने के लिए पूर्व सूचना (दिनों में)
questions.hint: Standard is 30 days notice by either party
questions.hint_hi: सामान्यतः दोनों पक्षों के लिए 30 दिन की सूचना

clauses.title: Parties & Agreement
clauses.plain: This agreement is made between {landlordName} (Property Owner) and {tenantName} (Tenant). Both agree to the terms written below in good faith.
clauses.legal: THIS INDENTURE OF LEASE is made and executed by and between {landlordName}, hereinafter called the LESSOR (which expression shall unless repugnant to the context include their legal heirs and assigns) of the ONE PART; AND {tenantName}, hereinafter designated the LESSEE (which expression shall include their legal representatives) of the OTHER PART.
clauses.note: Verify photo identity documents (Aadhaar or Passport) before signing.
clauses.note_hi: हस्ताक्षर से पहले आधार कार्ड अथवा पहचान पत्र अवश्य जांच लें।

clauses.title: Rented Premises
clauses.plain: The Owner gives the Tenant permission to live in the property located at {propertyAddress}. The property will be used purely for peaceful family residence and not for commercial activities.
clauses.legal: The Lessor hereby grants and demises unto the Lessee the residential premises situated at {propertyAddress}, together with all fixtures and fittings, to hold and occupy the same exclusively for private residential use and not for trade or commerce.
clauses.note: Ensure electricity and water connections are active and prior dues are cleared.
clauses.note_hi: सुनिश्चित करें कि पिछले बिजली और पानी के सारे बिल भरे जा चुके हैं।

clauses.title: Duration of Stay
clauses.plain: This tenancy starts on {startDate} and will run for {durationMonths} months. It can be renewed afterwards if both the Owner and the Tenant agree in writing.
clauses.legal: The term of this lease shall commence effective from {startDate} and remain in full force and effect for a determinate period of {durationMonths} months, subject to mutual extension under fresh covenants.
clauses.note: Keep track of the expiry date to renew timely.
clauses.note_hi: समय पर नवीनीकरण हेतु अंतिम तारीख ध्यान रखें।

clauses.title: Monthly Rent
clauses.plain: The Tenant will pay ₹{rentAmount} per month to the Owner. This payment must be made on or before the 5th day of every calendar month through UPI, bank transfer, or cheque.
clauses.legal: The Lessee covenants to pay unto the Lessor the agreed monthly rental of INR {rentAmount}/- strictly on or before the 5th day of each English calendar month, clear of all deductions, into the Lessor's designated bank account.
clauses.note: Never pay cash without taking a signed paper receipt.
clauses.note_hi: नकद भुगतान पर हमेशा रसीद अवश्य लें।

clauses.title: Security Deposit
clauses.plain: The Tenant has deposited an interest-free amount of ₹{depositAmount} with the Owner. The Owner must return this full amount within 7 days of the Tenant handing back the keys, subtracting only unpaid utility bills or physical damage beyond normal wear and tear.
clauses.legal: The Lessee has paid a sum of INR {depositAmount}/- as interest-free refundable security deposit. The Lessor covenants to refund the said sum within 7 business days of peaceful handover of keys, subject only to deductions for actual damages or utility arrears.
clauses.note: Keep the bank transfer proof of deposit safe until vacating.
clauses.note_hi: डिपॉजिट ट्रांसफर का प्रमाण मकान खाली होने तक सुरक्षित रखें।

clauses.title: Ending the Agreement
clauses.plain: Either the Owner or the Tenant can end this agreement at any time by giving {noticePeriodDays} days written notice, or by paying {noticePeriodDays} days rent in lieu of notice.
clauses.legal: Either party hereto may terminate this lease covenant at any time prior to expiration of term by serving a prior written notice of {noticePeriodDays} days or payment of rental sum in lieu thereof.
clauses.note: Always send written notice via WhatsApp or Email for record.
clauses.note_hi: सूचना हमेशा व्हाट्सएप या ईमेल पर लिखित रूप में दें।

warnings.title: Registration Alert: Period Exceeds 11 Months
warnings.title_hi: पंजीकरण चेतावनी: अवधि 11 महीने से अधिक है
warnings.message: Under Section 17 of the Indian Registration Act 1908, any lease exceeding 11 months must be compulsorily registered at the Sub-Registrar's office with applicable state stamp duty. An unregistered lease over 11 months cannot be admitted as primary evidence in an Indian court.
warnings.message_hi: भारतीय पंजीकरण अधिनियम की धारा 17 के अनुसार 11 माह से अधिक की लीज का सब-रजिस्ट्रार कार्यालय में पंजीकरण कराना अनिवार्य है।
warnings.action: Change duration to 11 months or register at the local Sub-Registrar office.
warnings.action_hi: अवधि को 11 महीने करें या सब-रजिस्ट्रार ऑफिस में पंजीकृत कराएं।

warnings.title: High Security Deposit
warnings.message: Your security deposit of ₹{depositAmount} is more than 3 times the monthly rent. Under the Model Tenancy Act, security deposits for residential properties are recommended to be capped at a maximum of 2 months' rent.
warnings.message_hi: आपकी सुरक्षा राशि मासिक किराए के 3 गुना से अधिक है। मॉडल टेनेंसी एक्ट में 2 महीने का किराया अनुशंसित है।
warnings.action: Consider setting the deposit between 1 to 2 months of monthly rent.
warnings.action_hi: डिपॉजिट 1 से 2 महीने के किराए के बराबर रखने पर विचार करें।
